scope: Targeted exploratory ABF colocalization; no MR or multi-signal fine mapping
gwas_independence: The combined-ancestry GWAS contains the European analysis; it is sensitivity, not independent replication
eqtl_prior_scale: Working effect-size prior in published slope units. Expression SD is not supplied; scale sensitivity is mandatory and this is not claimed to be a calibrated tissue-specific prior
eqtl_se: Derive abs(beta)/sqrt(F.isf(nominal_p,1,dof1)), equivalent to abs(beta)/t.isf(nominal_p/2,dof1). Use published nominal-test dof1, not optimized dof2; label SE as derived
variant_matching: Exact GRCh38 chromosome, position and unordered literal allele pair. Align direct/swapped alleles; no rsID-only matching, strand rescue or invented proxies. Exact matching permits indels when allele representations agree
palindromic_policy: Retain exact-coordinate/allele matched palindromic variants in the primary unsigned ABF calculation; record direction ambiguity and run exclusion sensitivity. No causal effect-direction interpretation
coverage: Keep all matched regional variants regardless of p-value. Verify full nominal source gene row counts against n_var_in_cis
interpretation: Posterior support under one causal variant per trait and explicit priors; not proof of gene causality or a cell-type-specific eQTL
prior_evidence_independence: EyeGEx and glaucoma source cohorts were already used by published gene nomination analyses. This is a new targeted fit using reused data, not independent genetic replication
